repo.description:
### Impact

The information which table (numeric ID) is shared with which groups or users and the respective permissions was not limited to privileged users.

### Patches


It is recommended that the Nextcloud Tables app is upgraded to 0.8.9, 0.9.6 or 1.0.1

### Workarounds

<!-- Remove not applicable sections -->

* Disable Tables app

### References

<!-- Link to the main/master PR only -->

* [HackerOne](https://hackerone.com/reports/3334165)
* [PullRequest](https://github.com/nextcloud/tables/pull/2148)

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory:

* Create a post in [nextcloud/security-advisories](https://github.com/nextcloud/security-advisories/discussions)
* Customers: Open a support ticket at [portal.nextcloud.com](https://portal.nextcloud.com)
repo.summary: Tables app share information not limited to relevant users
